lead.attribution: Locations as reported Wed 18 Nov — AP, Reuters.
lead.body: Iran said it targeted US drone and missile sites at Ali Al Salem air base in Kuwait, and Bahrain said it intercepted fresh Iranian attacks — the first Iranian attack on Kuwait since September, and Bahrain's third interception this week. The strikes follow US jets hitting an IRGC missile site on Qeshm Island on Tuesday, which Washington called self-defence. US officials report no injuries or damage; a Houthi missile aimed at Riyadh was destroyed.
lead.dek: Tehran says it hit a US base in Kuwait; Bahrain says it stopped attacks.
lead.headline: Gulf Tensions Escalate
